problemStatement: Patients in small towns face long wait times and difficulty accessing specialist doctors, resulting in delayed diagnosis and treatment.
startupDescription: A telemedicine platform connecting patients in tier-2 and tier-3 cities with verified specialists through video consultations, digital prescriptions, and AI-assisted symptom analysis.
targetAudience: Patients, clinics, and hospitals in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.
revenueModel: Commission per consultation and subscription plans
customerAcquisitionStrategy: Hospital partnerships, digital marketing, and referral programs
